prompt:

Input image: identity and rendering REFERENCE ONLY, the original curl illustration supplied here. Create a new exercise scene, not another curl.
Identity invariants: use the EXACT SAME adult grey mannequin identity, oval bald head, natural athletic build and muscle definition, body proportions, matte pale slate grey material, plain charcoal short training shorts and charcoal low-profile shoes as the reference. Same subdued studio lighting from upper left, flat very light cool-grey background #F3F5F7 with faint soft contact shadow, restrained premium 3D educational rendering. No lettering, logos, labels, arrows, panels or multiple poses. Entirely original illustration from the supplied original reference.
Exercise: MACHINE HACK SQUAT near-parallel bottom. Equipment override ONLY complete plate-loaded 45-degree hack squat machine. Subject faces outward AWAY from rails, back/buttocks rest on large inclined charcoal backpad of moving carriage; shoulders under TWO shoulder pads, hands on handles beside shoulders. Both whole feet shoulder width on fixed sloped foot platform below, knees bent near90 degrees and following toes. Carriage attached to two continuous diagonal guide rails behind backpad, modest plates on symmetric pegs. Neutral supported torso, heels stay on platform. Render square 1024x1024 PNG; entire figure/equipment inside frame.
